focus: system-skill-advisor, system-spec-kit, command and agent docs, runtime mirrors and generators
noveltyJustification: Eight findings, all new: the stage-one single-source statement, the router-reach coupling, two concrete router defects in system-skill-advisor, the spec-kit cross-hub leaf, and the mirror generator inventory were not covered earlier.
ruledOut: Treating all five phrase lists as live routing sources
Treating the Hermes mirror as hand-editable

label: Stage one reads exactly one file per skill, graph-metadata.json; SKILL.md frontmatter trigger_phrases and intent_signals are read by no runtime routing reader, so four of the five phrase lists are documentation the runtime ignores.

router-reach couples stage one to stage two: it reads graph-metadata.json as stage-one vocabulary and ROUTER.md as stage-two vocabulary and fails WRONG-HUB or OUTRANKED when an advertised phrase does not reach its declaring hub.

system-skill-advisor's router discovers feature_catalog and manual_testing_playbook with underscores and omits hooks/, so six intents (RECOMMEND, STATUS, REBUILD, VALIDATE_TOOL, CLI, HOOK) map to leaves discovery never sees and load_if_available silently skips them.
The HOOK leaf hooks/skill-advisor-hook.md is absent from the 121-leaf manifest, and typed_leaves claims to drop non-manifest paths but never reads the manifest, so it emits the invented pair.

system-spec-kit routes references/cli/shared-smart-router.md as one of its 46 Class S leaves, so editing the CLI helper changes spec-kit's manifest and aliases as well as every CLI mode's router contract.
The advisor-precedence paragraph is restated verbatim in 10 of 11 agent docs (11 'routing hints only' hits), and code.md:66 restates the sk-code router plus advisor fallback order for one agent only.

Only Hermes copies routing text: .hermes/skills holds generated markdown-only copies checked by sync-skills-hermes.cjs, while Claude and Devin symlink the whole skills tree, OpenCode mirrors per entry, and Codex and Cursor carry no skills mirror.

Cursor's rules/skill-routing.md packet list is hand-maintained with no generator and is not derived from the skill registry, so a new skill packet will not appear in it; only its Gate 1 pointer block is generated.
